Q6097.reason: In most states the fee tail is abolished or converted to fee simple, so the cousin holds fee simple and the grantor has no reversion left to pass to the niece.

Q5137.reason: The doctor would be describing what the x-rays show, and the x-rays themselves are the best evidence of that, so the testimony should be excluded.

Q5526.reason: Only D has a breaking into a dwelling at night with intent to commit a felony at the time of entry, since the intruder in A formed his intent after entering, C involves an open window in the afternoon, and B involves no entry.
